info.name: KhmeRiel Omnichannel MIS & POS Engine — Master RBAC API Collection
info.description: Complete, exhaustive REST API collection for KhmeRiel (Store Stock MIS & Point-of-Sale Engine) with 100% RBAC role-level classification (Public Storefront, Cashier/POS Operator, Inventory/Warehouse Manager, Executive Administrator).

item.name: 1. Public / Customer Storefront (No Auth Required)
item.description: Endpoints accessible by guest visitors, customer mobile apps, and e-commerce showcase storefronts.

item.name: 2. Level 1: Cashier & POS Operator (Role: CASHIER / STAFF)
item.description: Endpoints accessible by front-desk cashiers, retail clerks, shift operators, and POS terminal touchscreens.

item.name: 3. Level 2: Inventory & Warehouse Manager (Role: MANAGER)
item.description: Endpoints for catalog management, stock replenishment, PO generation, supplier logistics, and warehouse stock-ins.

item.name: 4. Level 3: Executive Administrator & Auditor (Role: ADMIN / SUPERADMIN)
item.description: Super-admin endpoints for user/employee creation, role assignment, audit logs, and master system settings.
